deviations.from: Practical task slots P01/P02 carry no command word in the work order, and objective_ids say 'choose 2-4'
deviations.to: P01 opens with State and P02 is labelled Describe, mark_tariff 10 each; P01 lists 4 objectives (03, 05, 07, 08) and P02 lists 5 (05, 06, 07, 08, 11)
deviations.why: Both are allowed words in this subject; P02 genuinely credits axis labels, scale, mean to significant figures, the chart choice and the joined bars, so listing fewer would hide credited skills

deviations.from: Work order objective titles for OBJ-8223-4.3-10 read 'Join plotted points correctly: line of best fit, smooth curve or ruled straight lines' while the syllabus line only asks for a clear, sharp and unbroken connecting line
deviations.to: Taught best fit, smooth curve and ruled straight segments, and flagged the rule for choosing between them as judged in claim notes
deviations.why: The syllabus wording does not say which form suits which data, so the choice rule is our reading and needs reviewer confirmation
